subject: literacy
concept: Understanding how common suffixes (-ful, -less, -ly) change a word's meaning or part of speech
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading morphology sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student attaches a suffix tile to a base-word tile and states the new meaning
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a suffixed word to the picture showing its new meaning
exercise.abstract: Student defines a suffixed word by identifying the suffix's meaning

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
